corrections.text: The article says "For September 3 the cited sources show same-day statements to a reporter." WIRED reports that only OpenAI's spokesperson gave WIRED a statement. Anthropic declined to comment, and the wording attributed to it comes from its status alerts. SpaceX, xAI's parent, did not respond to WIRED's request for comment; its Grok statement was part of public comments made on Thursday afternoon, and xAI's wording comes from its status page. The Overview's reference to what OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI "said" should be read the same way.

The Implications section says GitHub's entries show that choosing another model avoided the errors "in both provider-related cases". "Both" covers only the August 27 (Kimi K3) and October 28 (GPT-family models) entries the article examines. The same availability reports describe other incidents involving a provider that have no model choice to make: the August report attributes the August 20 Copilot cloud agent incident to a "provider-side outage" of a managed cloud database, and the October report attributes an October 5 Actions incident to a partial networking failure on the cloud provider's side.
